summaryZh: Mali 实验室开发基因组与转录组工程工具，服务于基因组功能解析和基因治疗。实验室还以人多能干细胞为主要模型，研究与工程化调控细胞命运的基因网络和细胞生态位，并研究肿瘤发生中的异常细胞转化。
researchQuestions: 基因调控网络和细胞生态位如何决定细胞命运？

evidence.quote: The Mali Lab UC San Diego
development of genome and transcriptome engineering toolsets and their application to systematic genome interpretation and gene therapy applications
study and engineering of gene regulatory networks and cellular niches governing cell fate specification during development utilizing human pluripotent stem cells as the core model system.
a key research thrust is also in dissecting aberrant cellular transformation processes such as during tumorigenesis.
